#include <iostream>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;
const long long INV2 = 499122177LL;

long long pow_mod(long long base, long long exp) {
    if (exp <= 0) return 1 % MOD;
    long long half = pow_mod(base, exp / 2);
    half = (half * half) % MOD;
    if (exp & 1) {
        half = (half * (base % MOD)) % MOD;
    }
    return half;
}

int main() {
    long long n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;

    long long d = r - l + 1;
    long long a = d / 2;
    long long b = d - a;
    long long nm = n * m;
    long long diff = llabs(a - b);

    long long ans = (pow_mod(d, nm) + pow_mod(diff, nm)) % MOD;
    ans = ans * INV2 % MOD;
    if (nm % 2 == 1) {
        ans = pow_mod(d, nm);
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
